description: Election Commission - The Madia Guidelines made by the Election Commission.
reasoning: This gazette contains media guidelines issued by the Election Commission specifically for the election to the Elpitiya Pradeshiya Sabha. It focuses on electoral processes, including regulations for media coverage during elections, guidelines for electronic media institutions, and provisions for ensuring fair and impartial election reporting. The content directly relates to electoral matters and falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral commission decisions and election-related regulations.
